benchmark.unit: one observed person-day from a distinct adult respondent
benchmark.food_universe: food/preparation/occasion combinations observed on that person-day, excluding fixed public tap water
benchmark.nutrient_coefficient_rule: For each POF food/preparation key, fit per-gram coefficient through the origin as sum(grams * reported_absolute_amount) / sum(grams squared) over all source records. No coefficient file is published.
benchmark.blank_addition_environment_crosswalk: preparation 99 only for the 12 source food codes with a unique preparation-99 environmental row

implementation.initial_population: same 66 vectors for the four algorithms within an instance/scenario/replicate: the observed baseline plus 65 independent uniform vectors within quantity bounds
implementation.constraint_handling: the framework's feasibility-first constraint violation ordering; no custom penalty or repair

runs.seed_rule: first 32 bits of SHA-256(sec2026-pof-person-day-v1|person_day_id|objective_subset|replicate_id), with zero replaced by one
runs.failed_run_policy: retain partial fronts and errors, never replace a seed or treat a partial run as complete

primary_analysis.endpoint: hypervolume of all feasible nondominated diets evaluated through the actual stopping point, normalized with fixed mathematical bounds
primary_analysis.within_instance_seed_summary: median across 20 planned replicates, counting failed runs with no feasible diet as zero hypervolume
primary_analysis.contrast_family: six unordered algorithm pairs in each of ten objective subsets, 60 contrasts total
primary_analysis.test: two-sided paired sign-flip permutation test on 24 respondent-level differences with 99999 Monte Carlo sign vectors
primary_analysis.effect: mean paired hypervolume difference with percentile 95 percent respondent bootstrap interval from 9999 resamples
primary_analysis.multiplicity: Holm adjustment across the 60 primary p-values
